data.role: Excluded from gradient updates. Dynamics checkpoint selection used death F1 on this stratum; action-intervention and autoregressive metrics are post-hoc.

protocol.ci_unit: Validation episodes, stratified by failure/expert source; windows within an episode remain clustered.
protocol.intervention: Flip only the last binary action in the K-action conditioning window while keeping the recorded visual context fixed.
protocol.nll_definition: Hard-target negative log likelihood under a softmax restricted to the visual-token vocabulary.

protocol.conditioning: Greedy autoregression under the recorded future action sequence; generated frames are fed back with ALIVE status.
